hero.title: Experience the Royal Thali at Khandani Rajdhani, Mantri Mall
hero.subtitle: Embark on an infinite culinary journey with authentic Rajasthani & Gujarati flavors, right here in Malleshwaram.

about.title: Unveiling The Royal Thali Tradition
about.paragraph1: For decades, Khandani Rajdhani has been a beacon of authentic Indian hospitality, bringing the rich culinary heritage of Rajasthan and Gujarat to your plate. Our commitment lies in preserving age-old recipes and serving an ever-changing thali that promises a new discovery with every visit, a true feast for your senses.
about.paragraph2: At our Mantri Mall, Malleshwaram location, we invite you to immerse yourself in a truly royal dining experience. From farm-fresh ingredients to the warmth of our service, every detail is crafted to transport you to the heart of traditional Indian feasts, ensuring an unforgettable culinary journey.
